movies.description: A retiring police officer reminisces about the most astounding day of his career. About a case that was never filed but continues to haunt him in his memories - the case of a man and a Wednesday.

movies.title: Munna Bhai M.B.B.S.
movies.cast: Sanjay Dutt, Arshad Warsi, Gracy Singh, Sunil Dutt
movies.description: A gangster sets out to fulfill his father's dream of becoming a doctor.

movies.title: Dil Chahta Hai
movies.cast: Aamir Khan, Saif Ali Khan, Akshaye Khanna, Preity Zinta
movies.description: Three inseparable childhood friends are just out of college. Nothing comes between them - until they each fall in love, and their wildly different approaches to relationships creates tension.

movies.title: Lagaan: Once Upon a Time in India
movies.cast: Aamir Khan, Raghuvir Yadav, Gracy Singh, Rachel Shelley
movies.description: The people of a small village in Victorian India stake their future on a game of cricket against their ruthless British rulers.

movies.title: Airlift
movies.cast: Akshay Kumar, Nimrat Kaur, Kumud Mishra, Prakash Belawadi
movies.description: When Iraq invades Kuwait in August 1990, a callous Indian businessman becomes the spokesperson for more than 170,000 stranded countrymen.

movies.title: Special Chabbis
movies.cast: Akshay Kumar, Anupam Kher, Manoj Bajpayee, Jimmy Sheirgill
movies.description: A gang of con-men rob prominent rich businessmen and politicians by posing as C.B.I and income tax officers.
